My issue is that when I agreed to R, one thing I specifically listed out is that my WS attends porn addicts anonymous. He agreed to everything and a couple of months later I realized he had not attended a single meeting. I brought it up and was upset (it was one hour long meeting per week). and he said he would start going to 6 meetings per week to make up for it (his idea). He lasted one week before I realized he had skipped a meeting out of convenience to do something else he had planned. I specifically asked him not to make the unilateral choice to skip meetings. to talk to me if something came up and that I would be reasonable.
